crossRefs.note: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and…
Joseph sent and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers,
that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and…
Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah…
“Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last…
Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and…
Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: For the Lord Yahweh says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there: and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.
translations.bsb: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
translations.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah, My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there: and the Assyrian hath oppressed them without cause.
